title: The Wall Gives Way
narrative: The group understands that the spell did not fail because Wang Qi was stupid or because the master lied. At the temple his mind held one clear intention. At home he carried shame, the wish to boast, and the need to prove himself all at once. The wall stayed solid because his heart was divided. Wang Qi finally faces the exam he fled, and the master lets him leave with a lesson rather than another trick.
truth_reveal: The warning concerned Wang Qi's divided intention.
His fear of the exam and desire to prove himself made the home attempt fail.

character_fates.wang_qi: Returns home honestly and begins rebuilding his confidence.
character_fates.wife: Finally tells him the examiner's words.
character_fates.master: Keeps teaching through questions rather than demonstrations.
character_fates.disciple: Learns that listening can reveal what pride hides.
character_fates.senior_disciple: Opens the work ledger as a record of growth.
character_fates.traveller: Returns the old ink and leaves the family to speak plainly.

title: Blaming the Mountain
narrative: The group decides the master staged an illusion. Wang Qi leaves convinced that the mountain cheated him, while the evidence of his divided mind remains unspoken. The wall becomes an excuse, and the real lesson is postponed.
truth_reveal: The temple demonstration depended on focused intention.
The home failure followed Wang Qi's shame and desire to boast.

character_fates.master: Lets him leave without forcing the truth.
character_fates.disciple: Remembers the sentence Wang Qi refused to finish.
character_fates.traveller: Keeps the old ink until Wang Qi is ready.

title: The Wrong Question
narrative: The group searches for a technical error in the words, but the evidence points to a deeper problem. Wang Qi memorizes the spell again and again, yet never asks what he was thinking when he ran at the wall. The mystery remains because the question was aimed at the syllables instead of the heart.
truth_reveal: The incantation was not the central cause of failure.
Wang Qi's motives changed between the temple and home.

character_fates.wang_qi: Repeats the technique without understanding it.
character_fates.wife: Waits for him to ask about the examination.
character_fates.master: Refuses to provide a second shortcut.
character_fates.senior_disciple: Keeps the evidence for another lesson.
character_fates.traveller: Leaves the mountain road before the argument ends.
